Class ControlNode

Namespace
ShapeEngine.UI
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an abstract base class for UI control nodes, providing core functionality for hierarchy, state, events, and input handling.

public abstract class ControlNode

Stretch

Stretch determines the size of the rect based on the parent rect size. Values are relative and in range 0 - 1. If Stretch values are 0 then the size of the rect can be set manually without it being changed by the parent rect size.

public Vector2 Stretch

Vector2

Properties

Active

Gets or sets whether this node is active. Changing this value triggers ShapeEngine.UI.ControlNode.ResolveActiveChanged() and may update children.

public bool Active { get; set; }

Property Value

bool

Remarks

  • parent active and change to active -> yes
  • parent active and change to inactive -> no
  • parent inactive and change to active -> yes
  • parent inactive and change to inactive -> no
